title: MCP server fails with placeholder credentials although the global config is correct
symptoms: MCP reports Site unreachable while the site is up
Works in one folder, fails in another
cause: ~/.claude.json can hold an mcpServers block at the top level and another per project path. The project block wins for that working directory, so leftover setup placeholders in it override good global credentials.
fix: Check the block under projects["/current/working/dir"].mcpServers first and fix the env values there.
